meta.one_liner: Buy strength: own stocks trading within 5% of their 52-week high, trail with the 50-day average.
meta.explainer_md: It feels wrong to buy a stock at its highs — which is exactly why it has historically worked. Academic research found stocks near their 52-week high tend to keep outperforming, because investors are slow to accept new highs. This strategy buys stocks within 5% of their one-year high (in confirmed uptrends) and holds until price drops below the 50-day average.
